description: This file defines the client interface and implementation for interacting with Kubernetes autoscaling v2 API resources, including functions for creating new clients with different configurations, setting default configurations, and accessing autoscaling resources like HorizontalPodAutoscalers.

classes.name: AutoscalingV2Client
classes.description: Client implementation for autoscaling v2 API, providing methods to access autoscaling resources and manage REST communication.

methods.name: HorizontalPodAutoscalers
methods.description: Returns an interface to manage HorizontalPodAutoscaler resources within a specified namespace.

methods.name: NewForConfig
methods.description: Creates a new AutoscalingV2Client using the provided REST configuration.

methods.name: NewForConfigAndClient
methods.description: Creates a new AutoscalingV2Client with a given configuration and HTTP client.

methods.name: NewForConfigOrDie
methods.description: Creates a new AutoscalingV2Client or panics if configuration is invalid.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new AutoscalingV2Client with an existing REST interface.

methods.name: RESTClient
methods.description: Returns the REST client used for communication with the API server.
